newsitem.title: UK: BAA buys 70 pct of Naples airport operator.
newsitem.headline: BAA buys 70 pct of Naples airport operator.

text.p: British airports operator BAA Plc said on Friday it had completed negotiations to buy a 70 percent stake in Italy's GESAC -- the operators of Capodichino Airport in Naples.

BAA said the share transfer was based on a 27.5 million stg valuation of the airport company. It gave no further financial details. Other shareholders include the City of Naples, the Province of Naples and Alitalia AZPla.MI.
BAA said Capodichino Airport was the main airport in southern Italy and handled 2.9 million passengers last year with 450 staff.
